headline: On the Guide tab the guide now comes first: the commonplace book sits below the lessons, folded, with a link at the end of Contents. Form C holds for 5 s. Both are live. The private-bank switch-over is built and green as draft PR #19. Phase 2 has not started because Chartres/epso-bank does not exist (or this account cannot see it) and the EPSO_BANK_TOKEN secret is not set.

shipped.title: Guide first: commonplace book below the lessons, folded; form C hold 5 s
shipped.live_checked: Deploy tagged deploy-2026-10-30 (03d0877), bundle index-DeejT8qE.js. Checked live in Chromium with Supabase blocked and one passage seeded. At 390 px, Contents starts at y=124 and the book heading at y=16808, after all 12 lessons. At 1280 px they are at y=104 and y=9411. The link 'My commonplace book · 1 passage' at the end of Contents opens the book (aria-expanded=true). scrollWidth equals the viewport, so there is no horizontal scroll. With form C set, a practice question starts at 'Options in 5 s'.

shipped.title: Private bank, phase 1: fetch from Chartres/epso-bank at build, public sample for clones
shipped.live_checked: Not merged, kept as a draft. CI is green on f077fd3 with the sample, because the secret is missing: the fetch step logged 'no EPSO_BANK_TOKEN', merged 30 questions, ran 225 tests with 5 skipped, and skipped e2e. Locally with the full bank: 230/230 tests pass and meta.json is unchanged. A clean clone without the bank passes npm ci, typecheck, tests and build.

private_bank.what_is_missing: Both. (1) Chartres/epso-bank: list_repos for this account shows only Chartres/epso-kviz and Chartres/epso-trainer. Attaching epso-bank to the session was also refused here, so even once it exists, the push of bank/ and verification/ may have to be Pavol's: the four git commands in docs/plans/private-bank.md. (2) EPSO_BANK_TOKEN: the CI run for PR #19 shows 'EPSO_BANK_TOKEN:' empty, so the secret is not set. Nothing was pushed or merged and the bank is still on main. The live site still serves all 231 questions.

decisions.question: Commonplace book: fold it, or move it below the guide?
decisions.default_taken: both: below the 12 lessons, folded, with a passage count and a link at the end of Contents
decisions.why: Moving it alone still leaves a long open list after the last lesson. Folded, it is one line. Reverting the fold is one prop.

decisions.question: Commonplace book: remember open/closed?
decisions.why: No new storage key. The Contents link opens it in one tap.

decisions.question: Private bank: size of the public sample
decisions.default_taken: 30: the first 10 verified governance and policy questions and the first 10 engineering questions, all already on /questions/*/
decisions.why: The exam simulation draws 10 per group, so it still works on a clone.

decisions.question: Private bank: e2e on PRs without the secret
decisions.default_taken: skip on the sample. It runs whenever the full bank is fetched, which means every push to main and every PR from this repo once the secret exists
decisions.why: The journeys search for questions that are only in the full bank. A non-PR run fails if it would ship the sample.

decisions.question: Private bank: licence cut-off date
decisions.why: A placeholder in a licence could ship by mistake. If #19 merges later, change the three dates to the merge date.

decisions.question: Private bank: do the verbal items and the study guide move?
decisions.why: Pavol said 'the bank'. The plan left this as his call.

next: Pavol: create the empty private repo Chartres/epso-bank and push bank/ and verification/ to it, using the four git commands in docs/plans/private-bank.md (step 2). Push verification/ too, because the fetch lists both folders. This session could not attach the repo, so plan for the push being his.
Pavol: make the fine-grained token (Chartres, only epso-bank, Contents read-only, longest expiry; note the date) and add it as the Actions secret EPSO_BANK_TOKEN on epso-kviz.

Then phase 2: re-run CI on PR #19. The log should show 'fetch-bank: 6 files from Chartres/epso-bank@main' and e2e should run. Mark it ready, squash-merge, check the live site still has 231 questions, and check data/bank is gone from main. If the merge date isn't 2026-10-30, update the licence dates first.

Before pulling #19 onto a machine that has the bank: pulling deletes the tracked data/bank and data/verification from the working tree. Restore with git restore --source=<switch-over commit>~1 -- data/bank data/verification, or fetch with the token.
Proposal (not built): sync the commonplace book's open/closed state or remember it per device, if Pavol finds himself reopening it often.
IndexNow: no static page content changed this round, so nothing to submit.
